newsitem.title: UK: BP signs $1 billion gas deal with Ruhrgas.
newsitem.headline: BP signs $1 billion gas deal with Ruhrgas.

text.p: British Petroleum Co. Plc said Monday it signed a $1 billion, 15-year contract to supply gas to Germany's Ruhrgas in a move to help establish BP as a major European gas player.

BP will start deliveries to Ruhrgas from its British offshore fields on Oct. 1 next year through a new link between Britain and mainland Europe when construction of the 240 km (149 mile) long Interconnector pipeline has been completed.
Industry watchers welcomed the deal, saying it was a further step for BP, which holds 25.5 percent of distributor Ruhrgas, to become a major gas operator on the continent.
BP will supply Ruhrgas with 15 billion cubic metres (530 billion cu ft) of gas.

"This is a landmark gas supply deal as it represents our first sale into continental Europe from the U.K. and our first use of the capacity we own in the Interconnector pipeline," BP Exploration Chief Executive Rodney Chase said.
